assertion.statement: From Kafka 4.0.0, the JMXReporter is only enabled if metrics are enabled in the Kafka resource or JMXReporter is explicitly added to metric.reporters.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Text names `.spec.kafka.metrics`, which does not match a schema path (spec.kafka.metricsConfig exists), and the Kafka version and the metric.reporters list entry cannot be pinned reliably from the evidence.; consequence: Evidence states the new enabling requirement but not what happens to environments that do neither.
